items.reason: The lower 2.5% strength is the gentler way to get the benzoyl peroxide wash you asked for, aimed at the look of breakouts.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps support the look of comfortable, balanced skin, since your scan shows moisture on the low side.
A mineral SPF suits daytime use while you are trying for a baby and helps keep skin tone looking even.

response.routine_note: Use the wash once a day at first, then moisturizer, and add sunscreen in the morning. Because you are trying to conceive, check any active product with your doctor or midwife first, and I have left out retinoids and strong peels for now.
